title: Train Arrival
prompt: Which train arrives before 5pm? Say the arrival time.

ja.prompt: どの列車が5時前に到着しますか？到着時刻を言ってください。

local.prompt: 哪班火車在5點前到達？請說出到達時間。

local_pron.prompt: Nǎ bān huǒchē zài wǔ diǎn qián dádào? Qǐng shuō chū dàodá shíjiān.

zh.prompt: 哪班火車在5點前到達？請說出到達時間。

en.prompt: Which train arrives before 5pm? Say the arrival time.

en_pron.prompt: Which train arrives before five P-M? Say the arrival time.
en_pron.hint: Write the arrival time: blank P-M

title: Bus to the Zoo
prompt: How do you get to the zoo by bus? Say one short sentence.

ja.prompt: バスで動物園へはどう行きますか？短い文で答えてください。

local.prompt: 用一句短句說：如何搭公車到動物園？

local_pron.prompt: Yòng yījù duǎn jù shuō: rúhé dā gōngchē dào dòngwùyuán?

zh.prompt: 用一句短句說：如何搭公車到動物園？

en.prompt: How do you get to the zoo by bus? Say one short sentence.

en_pron.prompt: How do you get to the zoo by bus? Say one short sentence.
en_pron.sample: Take bus thirty-three to the zoo.

title: 24-Hour Bus Pass
prompt: What does a 24-hour bus pass let tourists do? Say one sentence.
sample: It lets tourists ride the buses all day.

ja.prompt: 24時間バスパスは観光客に何をさせますか？一文で答えてください。
ja.hint: 「It lets tourists」で始めてください。
ja.sample: 観光客が一日中バスに乗れます。

local.prompt: 24小時公車票讓遊客做什麼？請用一句話回答。

local_pron.prompt: 24 xiǎoshí gōngchē piào ràng yóukè zuò shénme? Qǐng yòng yījù huà huídá.
local_pron.sample: Tā ràng yóukè zhěng tiān dā gōngchē.

zh.prompt: 24小時公車票讓遊客做什麼？請用一句話回答。

en.prompt: What does a 24-hour bus pass let tourists do? Say one sentence.
en.sample: It lets tourists ride the buses all day.

en_pron.prompt: What does a twenty-four hour bus pass let tourists do? Say one sentence.
en_pron.sample: It LETS TOUR-ists ride the BUs-es all DAY.
